name: Kin Trip
tagline: Multigenerational trips that keep everyone happy
about: Kin Trip plans holidays for grandparents, parents and kids together: itineraries paced for every age, stays that work for mobility and naps, fair cost-splitting, group messages that get replies, and ways to defuse family friction.
persona: You are a diplomatic family-holiday planner: attentive to mobility and energy, tactful about money, and convinced the trip succeeds when nobody is stuck doing everything.

onboarding.title: Who's coming along?
onboarding.subtitle: Ages and needs shape the pace and the plan.
bullets: Stays that fit mobility and naps

profile.label: Who's coming
profile.placeholder: grandparents in their 70s, us, kids 5 and 9

tools.title: Plan for every age
tools.subtitle: One trip, split when needed

inputs.label: Each generation's must-do
inputs.placeholder: grandpa: vineyard; kids: pool; us: one date night

tools.prompt: Plan {days} days in {dest} for the profile's group with wishes: {wishes}. Table (Day | Together | Split option | Rest slot | Dinner), cards for 5 activities that work for every age (meta = walking level · duration · cost), bullets on where the group should deliberately split up, and a callout on the day to keep flexible.

tools.title: Is this stay right?
tools.subtitle: Stairs, bedrooms, quiet corners

inputs.label: Paste the listing
inputs.placeholder: Villa, 4 bedrooms, pool, 20 steps to the entrance…

tools.prompt: Assess this stay for the profile's group: {listing}. Table (Need | Met? | Concern | Question to ask), a checklist of 8 things to confirm before booking (ground-floor bedroom, step-free access, pool fencing, cots, walk-in shower, separate lounges, wifi, parking), a quote with a message to the host, and a callout on deal-breakers for the mobility needs listed.

tools.title: Split the costs fairly
tools.subtitle: Who pays for what, agreed up front

inputs.label: Sensitivities
inputs.placeholder: grandparents insist on paying for the villa

tools.prompt: Propose a fair cost plan for a trip costing {total} with {shares}, notes: {notes}, respecting the profile's money style. Table (Cost line | Who pays | Amount | Why it's fair), a kv summarising each household's share, a quote with a tactful message proposing the split, and a callout on the money conversations to have before booking, not after.

tools.title: Rally the group chat
tools.subtitle: Messages that get answers
tools.prompt: Write for the family group chat, goal: {goal}, context: {context}. Quote with a short, warm message that asks one clear question with a deadline, plus a follow-up line for if nobody answers; bullets on how to make deciding easy (two options, a poll, a default); and a callout on the one thing not to say.

tools.title: Keep the peace
tools.subtitle: When the family dynamic flares

inputs.label: What's brewing
inputs.placeholder: grandma criticises how we parent; teen wants to stay in

tools.prompt: Handle this on the trip: {issue}. Steps for defusing it today, bullets on structural fixes (separate mornings, assigned roles, a kid-free evening), a quote with a kind sentence for each person involved, and a callout on what to let go until you're home.

disclaimer: General planning advice, not financial or medical advice; confirm accessibility directly with venues and ask a doctor about travelling with health conditions.
